# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 22 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 22:2 — Holy, holy, holy — Trisagion

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God of hosts" | Literal Sanctus, sanctus, sanctus Dominus |
| LOGOS | "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God of hosts" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God of hosts" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All agree. The Trisagion is a fixed liturgical formula. No divergence.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.
